description: Edit a block by id: title/url for links, text for headers, url for embeds, title and streaming links for music buttons, urls and rowTitle for rows of posts. visible=false hides it without deleting. startsAt/endsAt schedule it (null clears); spotlight=true shows it first, highlighted.

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

links.description: Music buttons only: every streaming link to show (Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube Music, TIDAL, Amazon Music, Deezer, SoundCloud, Bandcamp…), replacing the current list.

rowTitle.description: Rows of posts only: the title above the row ("" removes it).

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

url.description: A web address (https://…), a bare domain, or an email address.

urls.description: Rows of posts only: every post link, in order, replacing the current list.

name: update_block
title: Update a block
